description: This file contains tests for legacy delivery threadId support, verifying behavior of functions related to handling threadId in delivery payloads, including normalization, patching, merging, and detection of legacy hints.

methods.name: hasLegacyDeliveryHints
methods.description: Checks whether the input object contains legacy delivery hints, specifically a threadId property.

methods.name: buildDeliveryFromLegacyPayload
methods.description: Creates a new delivery payload object from legacy input, converting threadId to string.

methods.name: buildDeliveryPatchFromLegacyPayload
methods.description: Creates a patch object for legacy delivery, extracting threadId.

methods.name: mergeLegacyDeliveryInto
methods.description: Merges legacy delivery data into an existing delivery object, updating threadId.

methods.name: normalizeLegacyDeliveryInput
methods.description: Normalizes legacy delivery input, extracting and converting threadId, and stripping it from the payload.
